svg.title: IT Helpdesk agent request flow
svg.desc: User input at the top, input classification, a model-led ReAct loop, verified user approval, and user output plus separate SQLite stores at the bottom. Blocked messages do not enter persistent history.
svg.text: From user input to a verified answer and durable state
Verify the token; bind user and session
Load scoped history + current OS fact
Learn explicit OS fact; bound context
Pending proposal: go to User approval
Answer, clarify, or select a tool
Decline: no write; approve: resume A
A new message starts at the top
screened again in the same session.
Applied around model and tool calls
Shared request ID; no raw thinking.
Logical flow of the current local application. Storage writes occur during execution, not after delivery.
Blocked input is excluded from history. Unknown write outcomes stay explicit. Langfuse traces the request across services.
